claims.claim: Deploy records each environment's deployment in .promptarena/envs/<env>/deploy.state
dir 0750, file 0600, indented JSON
directory created when state is first saved
state JSON fields
pack_version: The deployed pack's top-level version
pack_checksum: SHA-256 checksum of the deployed pack, ignoring its compile time (sha256:{hex})
last_refreshed omitted if never refreshed
state created after deploy or deploy apply
state built from provider, env, pack version and checksum, adapter version, apply state
plan/apply/status/destroy pass prior state
A successful deploy destroy deletes the environment's state file and any plan saved for it.
adapter can compare pack checksum against prior state
Recompiling an unchanged pack gives the same checksum; apply reuses the saved plan only when the checksum matches
Each environment has its own state file, saved plan and lock under .promptarena/envs/<env>/
deploy and deploy plan refresh state before planning
refresh calls Status, updates state, records last_refreshed
refresh reports drifted resources with DRIFT (!)
import calls adapter Import and updates state
Deploy takes an exclusive lock on .promptarena/envs/<env>/deploy.lock
flock LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB; LockFileEx EXCLUSIVE|FAIL_IMMEDIATELY
deploy, deploy plan, deploy apply, deploy destroy, deploy refresh and deploy import take the lock before reading state, and so does the TUI's Deploy page; deploy status does not
state local only; lock does not coordinate across machines
An environment name must start with a letter or digit and contain only letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'
The CLI reads the legacy .promptarena/deploy.state only for the environment it records, moves it on first use; other environments stop with an error
Lock contention fails at once with: deploy lock is held by another process (pid <n>) for environment "<env>"; the CLI keeps the lock file
A failed pre-plan refresh does not stop the plan; it uses the stored state
deploy status, refresh and destroy stop with No deployment state found for environment "<env>" when that environment has none
